title: The 8 best AI scheduling assistants
summary: Based on in-depth research and testing, here are the nine best AI schedulers that can sort out the tricky bits of organizing your schedule.
body_markdown:
****


**Best for**


**Standout feature**


**Pricing**


Reclaim


Protecting your habits


Manages recurring events well


Free plan available; paid plans from $10/user/month (billed annually)


Motion


AI-assisted project management


AI employees that optimize schedules and document SOPs


From $19/month (billed annually)


SkedPal


Time-blocking


Time budgeting feature with natural language input


From $9.95/month (billed annually)


****Calendly


Teams already on Calendly


Routing forms that qualify and direct leads to the right rep automatically


Free plan available; paid plans start at $10/month (billed annually)


Akiflow


Integrations and single task inbox


AI labels tasks automatically and manages them across platforms


From $34/month


Structured


Planning with your voice


Voice-based task and event planning


Free plan available; paid plans from $6.99/month (varies by region)


Toki


Managing your calendar from your phone


Create events from voice notes, text messages, screenshots, and forwarded emails. Works directly in Telegram. It can also call you with reminders


Free plan available; paid plans from $3/month (billed annually)


Clara


Having a virtual assistant in your email


Scheduling handled entirely by cc'ing Clara in email threads


From $80/month


Kronologic


Following up with more leads


Automated scheduling for sales leads; can replace Calendly


From $13/user/month (billed annually)
